prompt.project_info: Create a raw photorealistic bathroom selfie with wet-hair texture and natural phone-camera imperfections.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair, distinct dark roots, messy high bun, loose strands, tan natural skin, silver hoops, and a star pendant, wearing an opaque black athletic swim top and opaque black swim shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle selfie in a tiled shower corner, subject seated comfortably or standing naturally rather than crouched forward, right arm toward the camera, grey square tiles, chrome shower mixer, white towel, wet floor reflections, and face clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct overhead bathroom light creates realistic highlights on water droplets and hard tile shadows; candid raw unfiltered phone aesthetic with muted grey and black palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-angle wide-angle smartphone selfie, deep focus from face to tiled floor, natural skin pores and water droplets, realistic dynamic range and subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with platinum blonde hair and distinct dark roots in a messy high bun, loose strands framing her face, natural tan skin, large silver hoop earrings, and a thin silver chain with a star pendant takes a raw bathroom selfie. She wears an opaque black athletic swim top and opaque black swim shorts and sits comfortably or stands naturally in a tiled shower corner, with her face visible and one arm reaching toward the camera. Grey square tiles, a chrome shower mixer, a white towel, and wet floor reflections fill the environment. Bright direct overhead light creates realistic water highlights and firm tile shadows. Use a high-angle wide phone lens, deep focus, natural pores and droplets, and an unfiltered photorealistic amateur selfie look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bandeau-only styling, minimal bottoms, cleavage emphasis, deep squat, crouched sexual pose, forward lean, provocative gaze, nudity, transparent clothing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
